messages:
lina (People Ops): quick Q — engineer on 12-night client trip in Lisbon (May 3-14). Team booked a short-term corporate apartment (single invoice from host). Is reimbursement treated the same as a hotel? per diem? receipts?

jamal (Finance): We can reimburse but need an itemized invoice showing nightly rate + cleaning/service fees and proof of payment. Accommodation reimbursed on actuals up to cap. Per diem for meals is separate. :money_with_wings:

sasha (Travel Ops): Ops notes: if vendor bills Redwood via AP, employee should not claim the accommodation in Concur/Expensify. If employee paid and was refunded, submit with vendor invoice + bank/card proof. For apartments we require guest name and property address on the invoice.

people-ops-bot: Policy excerpt — "Accommodation: itemized receipt required. Meals: per diem applies unless meals are included on the lodging invoice; if included, per diem will be prorated."

miguel (Engineering): Our card declined so vendor invoiced the company. Do I need to do anything besides adding the trip record to Concur?

jamal (Finance): If AP paid vendor, Miguel: add vendor invoice number and dates to the Concur trip, set accommodation claim to $0, and attach the AP payment/reference in trip notes. Finance will reconcile.

lina (People Ops): Meal prorating rule: full-board days -> per diem 0; breakfast-only days -> reduce per diem by 20%. I'll DM the prorate table. :thumbsup:

sasha (Travel Ops): Also flag VAT handling — EU invoices often show VAT. If invoice is to Redwood and AP paid, Finance will handle VAT recovery. If employee paid, Jamal will advise on reclaiming VAT.

miguel (Engineering): I have the vendor invoice PDF and AP ref INV-2026-0453. I'll attach both and mark accommodation $0. Anything else?

jamal (Finance): If the vendor invoice is lump-sum with no line items, request a breakdown or a brief vendor attestation email confirming nights and dates.

lina (People Ops): Action items: Miguel attach invoice + AP ref; Sasha confirm vendor attestation flow; Jamal confirm VAT recovery approach. I'll update the travel FAQ with the apartment example this afternoon.
